csv_scope_of_work: The San Jose Mineta International Airport, may be seeking a Consultant to provide developers and operators for the long-term ground lease and development of approximately 15 acres of airport property. This opportunity is aimed at delivering high-quality General Aviation Aeronautical facilities and services that enhance the Airport s role as a regional hub, while supporting innovation, strong operations, and environmental stewardship. The selected proposer will design, build and operate a comprehensive aviation-focused development that contributes to the continued growth of SJC and the surrounding community. SJC Airport hosted an Industry Outreach Day on June 10, 2026 to share preliminary information about the site and the anticipated opportunity, answer questions and gather industry feedback from prospective proposers. A recording of the presentation is available below for anyone who was unable to attend or would like to review the information shared during the session. Additional resources, including the site assessment and event sign-in sheet, are also available for reference.
